questions.question: Which of these keywords is used to prevent a method from being overridden?
What does the 'static' keyword mean when applied to a variable?
options: The variable's value cannot be changed
The variable belongs to the class, not an instance
The variable can only be accessed by subclasses
questions.answer: The variable belongs to the class, not an instance
